summary: This bill imposes sanctions on foreign individuals and entities involved in transactions related to Iranian petroleum products, blocking their property in the U.S. and making them inadmissible for entry into the U.S., with exceptions for humanitarian aid and national security.

scores.thoughts: This bill imposes sanctions on individuals and entities involved in transactions related to Iranian petroleum products. These sanctions are a form of protectionist policy aimed at isolating Iran economically, thus directly impacting trade by restricting it.
